verdict.rationale: WezTerm's feature docs say its SGR mouse reporting "works in vim and tmux", so running tmux inside the terminal is a documented use. It also ships its own tmux-like multiplexer for local and remote (SSH domain) sessions. A community report notes WezTerm's image support didn't play well with tmux, a limitation rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: documented native tmux control-mode integration, dedicated tmux-compatibility docs, and reliable image passthrough under tmux.
